hero.title: Research
hero.lead: Find papers, reports, legal texts and datasets on bonded labour in Nepal. Search by topic, place or author, then narrow the list by labour system, theme, method or decade.

search.label: Search research papers
search.placeholder: Try “Kamaiya land”, “Haliya rehabilitation” or an author
search.hint: Every word you type must appear in the paper. Spellings such as Halia/Haliya and Harawa/Haruwa are matched.

results.emptyBody: Try fewer or different words, check the spelling, or remove a filter.

note.label: Cataloguing note:
note.text: Partial metadata means a core field was absent from the workbook. Verify records before citation.
